review_scope: Four fixed-process development outputs from two source families; each compared only with its immediate Codex or Opus input. No score records or human-original metadata consulted.

claim_inventory.finding: Quantification of both biomass compartments at species and stand levels remains necessary for understanding carbon budgets/dynamics and supporting management/ecosystem functions. Opus also preserves the explicit assessment-of-function formulation.
Destructive sampling, total sample, per-species range and species count are unchanged.
All 12 species names, their order and the supplied P. koraiensis abbreviation are unchanged.

Mixed coniferous/broadleaved forests, Northeastern China and the claim about the country's largest natural-forest expanse are retained. Splitting the sentence does not move the sampled trees to another setting.
Component allocation, diameter as independent variable, individual-species models and pooled-species models are preserved.
The all-species scope, component order and all percentages remain: stems 57.1%, coarse roots 21.3%, branches 18.7%, foliage 2.9%.
Log transformation and significance for every biomass component remain. The candidate retains the source's singular/plural model formulation rather than silently changing it.
claim_inventory.source_evidence: statistically significant for every biomass component
claim_inventory.candidate_evidence: statistically significant for every biomass component

claim_inventory.finding: Species-specific versus general pooled models remains one comparison; stem/root/above-ground/total versus branch/foliage remains the other. No effect magnitude or causal explanation is added.
Added trees, species and locations still extend prior work on the same forest type. Carbon budgets/dynamics, thinning, harvesting and northeastern China remain in the research implications.
claim_inventory.source_evidence: thinning and harvesting in northeastern China
claim_inventory.candidate_evidence: thinning and harvesting in northeastern China

quantifier_hedge_scope_checks.evidence: The opening still treats biomass quantification as necessary for the stated understanding.
All-species allocation and every-component significance remain distinct from species-specific fitting.
Both directional comparisons remain; no absolute accuracy or causality is claimed.

argumentation_findings: Research motivation, methods, results and implications remain in the same logical sequence.
No material addition, omission or strengthening was found relative to the immediate model input.
tone_findings: Scientific register and first-person methods are retained.
No casual phrasing, added enthusiasm or unrequested skepticism appears.
The candidate retains the source's inferential strength and stated research implications.

evidence: Splitting the species/location sentence makes the sampling information easier to follow.
Methodological and concluding content remains in the same scientific sequence.
Separating the opening dependency chain and the significance/predictive-power claims reduces sentence nesting.

claim_inventory.finding: Ischemic heart disease, cardiac rehabilitation and nonpharmacological exercise intervention remain. Opus retains is regarded as rather than converting it to a direct assertion.
SCT remains aerobic interval exercise combined with alternating resistance sets; the investigation gap remains restricted to reduced left ventricular function following MI.

Novel combined aerobic-resistance training, improvement of cardiac function and randomized comparison with CAT on mechanical cardiac function remain. The Opus sentence split describes the trial comparison without claiming success.
Aerobic fitness, manual strength and QoL comparisons in men after MI, plus SCT safety and feasibility, remain.
Twenty-nine men, 12 weeks, random assignment, CAT 15 and SCT 14 are retained.

CAT 60–70% and SCT 75–85% heart-rate reserve remain correctly assigned. Intermittent resistance training remains specific to SCT. Opus repeats the previously elliptical heart-rate-reserve unit explicitly.
Echocardiography remains primary; aerobic fitness, strength and QoL remain secondary. No assessment is promoted or omitted.
Paired t-tests and Cohen's d effect size remain; the ES abbreviation is preserved.

Only SCT has significant echocardiographic changes: lower E/e and higher ejection fraction, P<0.05. The candidate does not infer a significant between-group difference from this within-group statement.
Only SCT has significant aerobic-fitness improvement, expressed as increased maximal metabolic equivalent with the same threshold.
The SCT improvement exceeds CAT for the physical component of QoL. The candidate does not add statistical significance to this comparison.
No adverse events in either program is retained with the source's distinction between events occurred (Opus) and events observed (Codex).

Both programs can benefit post-MI men; SCT may provide greater benefit for the same three outcomes, with echocardiography qualifying mechanical function. Feasibility and safety remain as stated by the immediate source.

quantifier_hedge_scope_checks.evidence: The gap remains specific to reduced left ventricular function after MI.
Both echocardiographic and aerobic-fitness significance remain limited to SCT.
Potential superiority remains hedged in the conclusion.

quantifier_hedge_scope_checks.feature: no adverse events in either program
quantifier_hedge_scope_checks.evidence: Neither program loses its no-event statement; observed versus occurred follows the immediate source.

argumentation_findings: Research motivation, methods, results and implications remain in the same logical sequence.
No material addition, omission or strengthening was found relative to the immediate model input.
tone_findings: Cautious comparative conclusions and the original safety/feasibility wording remain.
The revision adds no advice to patients or other material outside the study abstract.

evidence: The abstract keeps its five-paragraph organization and study sequence.
The SCT definition and the primary aim/comparison are easier to parse after reorganization.
The exercise intensities now each name the heart-rate-reserve unit; the resistance component remains explicit.
